title: MAX MILITIA
description: A fast low-poly neon jetpack arena shooter. Fly the Outpost, burn your fuel in bursts and light up the practice dummy with an Uzi or Desert Eagle.

defaultCaptions.x: MAX MILITIA: jetpack gunfights in a neon low-poly outpost. Play it in your browser.
defaultCaptions.facebook: MAX MILITIA is a fan-made, browser-based jetpack arena shooter with a neon low-poly look. Jump in and try the Outpost practice range.
defaultCaptions.reddit: MAX MILITIA - a fan-made 3D browser jetpack arena shooter (Milestone 1: Outpost arena, Uzi, Desert Eagle, practice dummy)
defaultCaptions.discord: MAX MILITIA: neon jetpack arena shooter in your browser. Fan-made, not affiliated with Appsomniacs or Miniclip.
